waypoints.title: Foundation
waypoints.description: Repository, mission boundaries, PostgreSQL authority, diagnostics-first contract, and reproducible tooling.
accept: Verified foundation commit
Required reading and architecture decisions present
waypoints.boundary: No operational autonomy beyond foundation contracts.

waypoints.title: River event runtime
waypoints.description: Transactional append, idempotent replay, correlation, and aggregate reading.
accept: PostgreSQL event append and replay acceptance
Idempotency verified
waypoints.boundary: Events record state; they do not execute arbitrary actions.

waypoints.title: Diagnostic persistence
waypoints.description: Stable checkpoints, PostgreSQL diagnostic evidence, emergency spool, and Cookbook linkage.
accept: Normal persistence acceptance
Induced database fallback acceptance
waypoints.boundary: Emergency spool is evidence, never authoritative workflow state.

waypoints.title: Riverview Relay
waypoints.description: Durable work orders, restricted execution, persistent worker, status visibility, and MCP mailbox.
accept: Full mailbox-to-result loop
Failure escalates without approval drip
waypoints.boundary: Only registered actions cross into execution.

waypoints.title: Relay data foundation
waypoints.description: Waypoints, actions, work orders, attempts, leases, heartbeats, and escalations.
accept: Claim-heartbeat-complete-timeout lifecycle
waypoints.boundary: Database transitions are transactional and auditable.

waypoints.title: Restricted local runner
waypoints.description: Hash-pinned fixed adapters, bounded parameters, subprocess evidence, and hard timeouts.
accept: Approved no-op succeeds
Timeout terminates and escalates
waypoints.boundary: No database-supplied shell text or arbitrary command execution.

waypoints.title: Steward status view
waypoints.description: Local read-only auto-refresh view of roadmap, workers, work, diagnostics, and escalations.
accept: Local HTTP and API projection acceptance
Nonlocal bind rejected
waypoints.boundary: Read-only localhost surface; no execution controls.

waypoints.title: Read-only MCP Relay
waypoints.description: Expose bounded tools for waypoints, reports, diagnostics, Cookbook entries, workers, and escalations.
accept: New ChatGPT conversation retrieves latest verified state
Tools expose no write authority
waypoints.boundary: No enqueue, SQL, filesystem, secret, or Undercurrent access.

waypoints.title: Full-loop mailbox
waypoints.description: Correlated approved-message submission, acknowledgement, result return, timeout, and Steward paging.
accept: Doorbell-to-result loop without manual copying
Timeout pages Steward exactly once
waypoints.boundary: Writes are typed mailbox operations, never general database access.

waypoints.title: Grace and Continuous Momentum Engine
waypoints.description: Grace advances objectives through events, checkpoints, exceptions, and resumable momentum.
accept: Objective advances without routine Steward babysitting
Every stall has bounded recovery
waypoints.boundary: Grace coordinates progression but does not replace Steward authority.

waypoints.title: Grace identity and authority contract
waypoints.description: Define Grace responsibilities, prohibited powers, escalation rights, and durable identity.
accept: Authority tests reject unauthorized state changes
waypoints.boundary: No implicit authority inherited from conversation text.

waypoints.title: Objective and stage model
waypoints.description: Persist objectives, stages, readiness, required evidence, dependencies, and final outputs.
accept: Objective resumes from PostgreSQL after process restart
waypoints.boundary: No JSON-file workflow authority.

waypoints.title: Momentum evaluation loop
waypoints.description: Evaluate completed work, choose the next ready stage, enqueue approved work, and record causation.
accept: Multi-stage objective advances automatically
waypoints.boundary: Only declared transitions and approved actions are eligible.

waypoints.title: Stall and stale-work detection
waypoints.description: Detect expired leases, absent providers, missing evidence, circular dependencies, and idle objectives.
accept: Each induced stall maps to a stable checkpoint
waypoints.boundary: Detection does not silently mutate user intent.

waypoints.title: Recovery and retry policy
waypoints.description: Apply retry-safe recovery, substitute providers when allowed, or escalate with complete evidence.
accept: Retry-safe work recovers once
Unsafe work requires explicit decision
waypoints.boundary: No unlimited retries or recursive work creation.

waypoints.title: Steward checkpoint routing
waypoints.description: Pause only at ideation, selected authority gates, unresolved exceptions, and final acceptance.
accept: Routine path completes without approval drip
Exceptions arrive with options and evidence
waypoints.boundary: The Steward remains front and center at required creative and final points.

waypoints.title: Provider registry and parallel execution
waypoints.description: Capability-aware scheduling across Codex seats, RTX 4090, P100, local AI, and future providers.
accept: Parallel lanes execute without duplicated ownership
Capacity affects dispatch
waypoints.boundary: Provider credentials and private data stay outside ordinary task payloads.

waypoints.title: Capability registry
waypoints.description: Persist provider identity, supported tasks, models, context limits, restrictions, and health probes.
accept: Dispatcher can query compatible healthy providers
waypoints.boundary: Claims require measured evidence, not descriptive labels alone.

waypoints.title: Capacity and fuel telemetry
waypoints.description: Ingest seat quotas, GPU health, memory, queue depth, freshness, and reset windows.
accept: Stale readings are distinguished from current capacity
waypoints.boundary: Advisory indices never masquerade as physical capacity.

waypoints.title: Dispatch policy
waypoints.description: Choose providers by capability, cost, sensitivity, availability, expected duration, and escalation need.
accept: Deterministic routing explains every provider choice
waypoints.boundary: No OpenAI API model route.

waypoints.title: Parallel lanes and path ownership
waypoints.description: Assign independent work lanes with exclusive file/path ownership and shared correlation.
accept: Concurrent workers do not overwrite one another
waypoints.boundary: Parallelism requires separable work and explicit merge ownership.

waypoints.title: Result reconciliation
waypoints.description: Validate, compare, merge, reject, or escalate parallel results with provenance.
accept: Conflicting results produce bounded reconciliation evidence
waypoints.boundary: Consensus does not override acceptance tests or Steward authority.

waypoints.title: Backpressure and fairness
waypoints.description: Throttle queues, reserve escalation capacity, and prevent one project or provider from starving others.
accept: Capacity exhaustion pauses safely and resumes after reset
waypoints.boundary: No busy-loop polling or unbounded task fan-out.

waypoints.title: Local execution adapters
waypoints.description: Deterministic adapters for Codex CLI, RTX 4090 local AI, P100 workloads, and evidence return.
accept: Each provider completes one bounded real task
Failures return structured evidence
waypoints.boundary: Adapters expose named capabilities, not unrestricted shells.

waypoints.title: Common execution envelope
waypoints.description: Define inputs, outputs, timeout, resource request, classification, evidence, and idempotency for adapters.
accept: All adapter contracts validate against one envelope
waypoints.boundary: Payloads reference large data rather than embedding it.

waypoints.title: Codex CLI adapter
waypoints.description: Launch repo-aware Codex CLI tasks, capture progress and results, and reconcile Git state.
accept: One repository task completes and reports exact commit or no-change result
waypoints.boundary: No hidden pushes or inferred publication claims.

waypoints.title: RTX 4090 local-AI adapter
waypoints.description: Run compatible reasoning, generation, and analysis jobs with GPU health and resource evidence.
accept: Measured 4090 job completes with model and resource provenance
waypoints.boundary: Sensitive outputs follow classification and storage policy.

waypoints.title: P100 local-AI adapter
waypoints.description: Route suitable lower-priority or compatible workloads to the P100 with capability constraints.
accept: Measured P100 job completes or is correctly rejected as incompatible
waypoints.boundary: No assumed feature parity with the RTX 4090.

waypoints.title: Local adult-content work lane
waypoints.description: Allow locally hosted models to perform lawful adult-themed creative work outside OpenAI-restricted paths.
accept: Classification routes eligible work locally
Restricted providers never receive the payload
waypoints.boundary: Adults only, lawful content, explicit classification, and Undercurrent-compatible storage.

waypoints.title: Adapter evidence and recovery
waypoints.description: Capture logs, artifacts, resource use, checkpoints, and smallest safe restart procedure for every adapter.
accept: Fresh conversation repairs each induced adapter failure from Cookbook evidence
waypoints.boundary: Logs exclude secrets and unapproved private payloads.

waypoints.title: MCP and Playwright reasoning bridge
waypoints.description: Connect interactive ChatGPT reasoning to Grace through a bounded mailbox and Playwright doorbell.
accept: Correlated request and response complete without copying
No OpenAI API usage
waypoints.boundary: Playwright wakes; MCP carries typed data; neither receives unrestricted execution.

waypoints.title: MCP resource model
waypoints.description: Publish read-only resources for roadmap, work, reports, diagnostics, Cookbook, and capacity.
accept: Resources are bounded, paginated, and classification-filtered
waypoints.boundary: Undercurrent and credentials are excluded by default.

waypoints.title: Mailbox schema and correlation
waypoints.description: Persist requests, acknowledgements, claims, responses, expiry, and causation.
accept: Duplicate delivery returns one correlated response
waypoints.boundary: Mailbox messages are typed and size-bounded.

waypoints.title: Playwright doorbell
waypoints.description: Notify the designated ChatGPT window to inspect its MCP mailbox and record wake evidence.
accept: Doorbell wakes correct conversation
Failure pages Steward after bounded timeout
waypoints.boundary: Automation does not scrape unrelated conversations or bypass authentication.

waypoints.title: Reasoning response return
waypoints.description: Return structured advice, escalation, or seed results to Grace with citations and correlation.
accept: Grace consumes one response and advances the correct objective
waypoints.boundary: Reasoning output is advisory until accepted by declared workflow rules.

waypoints.title: Interactive Steward seed submission
waypoints.description: Allow the Steward to send an approved idea from an active ChatGPT conversation into Grace via MCP.
accept: Seed creates one traceable objective draft
Steward confirms promotion
waypoints.boundary: Conversation text never silently becomes executable work.

waypoints.title: Bridge replay and recovery
waypoints.description: Recover missed wakes, expired claims, browser restarts, and duplicate responses without losing correlation.
accept: Induced browser and MCP failures recover or escalate exactly once
waypoints.boundary: Retries remain bounded and idempotent.

waypoints.title: Knowledge recovery and searchable conversation archive
waypoints.description: Preserve, search, and mine ChatGPT conversation exports and project evidence.
accept: Known historical idea is retrieved with source provenance
waypoints.boundary: Archive ingestion never grants execution authority.

waypoints.title: Export inventory and ingestion
waypoints.description: Inventory PDFs, MHTML, native exports, attachments, and timestamps; ingest without destructive conversion.
accept: Representative exports ingest with hashes and source paths
waypoints.boundary: Original files remain immutable evidence.

waypoints.title: Conversation normalization
waypoints.description: Extract participants, turns, dates, projects, code blocks, files, and cross-chat references.
accept: Normalized turn order matches source export
waypoints.boundary: Uncertain attribution is labeled, not guessed.

waypoints.title: Search and retrieval index
waypoints.description: Provide lexical and semantic retrieval with project, date, speaker, classification, and source filters.
accept: Benchmark queries retrieve known conversations
waypoints.boundary: Search results enforce classification before ranking.

waypoints.title: Idea and decision extraction
waypoints.description: Identify candidate ideas, decisions, abandoned paths, unresolved questions, and useful artifacts.
accept: Candidates retain source quotes and confidence
Steward approves promotion
waypoints.boundary: Extraction does not rewrite history or auto-create execution work.

waypoints.title: Project memory publication
waypoints.description: Promote accepted findings into the correct repository memory, decision, roadmap, or backlog artifact.
accept: Promoted item links back to immutable source evidence
waypoints.boundary: Repository-specific memory remains separated by project.

waypoints.title: Operator conversation environment
waypoints.description: Open WebUI, SillyTavern, transcription, screenshots, notifications, voice, and remote communication adapters.
accept: Steward completes a multimodal task without keyboard dependence
waypoints.boundary: Interfaces consume kernel capabilities; they do not become authoritative state.

waypoints.title: Open WebUI adapter
waypoints.description: Connect general Estate conversations to approved models, memory references, and notification state.
accept: Conversation routes to approved provider and retains correlation
waypoints.boundary: No direct unrestricted database or shell access.

waypoints.title: SillyTavern adapter
waypoints.description: Support resident and entertainment conversations with appropriate local-provider routing.
accept: Resident context and classification route correctly
waypoints.boundary: Creative context is isolated from operational authority.

waypoints.title: Dictation and transcription input
waypoints.description: Capture Windows transcription and later local speech-to-text as first-class input events.
accept: Dictated request reaches correct conversation with recoverable transcript
waypoints.boundary: Raw audio retention follows explicit data policy.

waypoints.title: Screenshot and artifact intake
waypoints.description: Accept clipboard screenshots and attachments with hashes, classification, storage references, and correlation.
accept: Screenshot is traceable from conversation to stored artifact
waypoints.boundary: Large files remain outside source control and ordinary event payloads.

waypoints.title: Notification adapter
waypoints.description: Deliver completion, exception, capacity, and doorbell notices; initially permit a bounded Estate compatibility bridge.
accept: Critical escalation reaches Steward once
Routine success remains unobtrusive
waypoints.boundary: Notifications contain summaries and references, not sensitive payloads.

waypoints.title: Voice and remote channel
waypoints.description: Add synthesized voice and authenticated phone/Bluetooth remote interaction with session boundaries.
accept: Authenticated remote request and response complete safely
waypoints.boundary: No unauthenticated remote execution or ambient open microphone.

waypoints.title: Command chair and physical controls
waypoints.description: Integrate Stream Deck, rotary keys, mouse hotkeys, keyboard, and future command-chair devices.
accept: Physical input produces deterministic acknowledged action
waypoints.boundary: Every gesture maps to a named action; destructive gestures require safeguards.

waypoints.title: Device and control inventory
waypoints.description: Record USB devices, Stream Deck profiles, rotary keys, mouse bindings, keyboard plans, and ownership.
accept: Every connected control has identity, capability, and status
waypoints.boundary: Legacy profiles are evidence until explicitly promoted.

waypoints.title: Gesture grammar
waypoints.description: Model single, double, triple, quadruple taps, holds, rotations, chords, and timing windows.
accept: Recorded gestures resolve deterministically without collisions
waypoints.boundary: Long-hold shutdown remains separately guarded and visible.

waypoints.title: Stream Deck state bridge
waypoints.description: Render live health, fuel, readiness, errors, profiles, and action acknowledgement on keys.
accept: Key state matches PostgreSQL projection after action
waypoints.boundary: Display state never becomes a second authority.

waypoints.title: Rotary, mouse, and keyboard adapters
waypoints.description: Map remaining physical devices through the same typed gesture and action contracts.
accept: Each device passes identity, gesture, and disconnect recovery tests
waypoints.boundary: Device-specific code remains adapter-local.

waypoints.title: Physical safety and recovery
waypoints.description: Handle disconnects, stuck inputs, duplicate taps, profile drift, emergency stop, and shutdown confirmation.
accept: Induced device faults fail safe and identify checkpoint
waypoints.boundary: No single accidental gesture performs irreversible broad action.

waypoints.title: Engineering capacity and project intake
waypoints.description: Turn Riverview into an engineering department capable of accepting, decomposing, executing, and delivering projects.
accept: CueMastery pilot traverses intake through verified delivery
waypoints.boundary: Projects retain their own repositories, decisions, and acceptance authority.

waypoints.title: Project intake contract
waypoints.description: Capture mission, repository, constraints, artifacts, acceptance, urgency, sensitivity, and Steward checkpoints.
accept: Incomplete intake blocks with exact missing fields
waypoints.boundary: No inferred goals replace project-owner intent.

waypoints.title: Repository archaeology and map
waypoints.description: Produce bounded dependency, runtime, data, test, and deployment maps before material changes.
accept: Map identifies owned seams and unknowns without multi-day rediscovery
waypoints.boundary: Mapping is evidence, not permission to rewrite unrelated systems.

waypoints.title: Work decomposition and lane assignment
waypoints.description: Convert accepted scope into dependency-aware tasks, path ownership, provider routing, and checkpoints.
accept: Tasks can execute in parallel without scope collision
waypoints.boundary: Decomposition stops at useful execution granularity.

waypoints.title: Implementation and review pipeline
waypoints.description: Run work, tests, diagnostics, reconciliation, review, and controlled Git publication.
accept: Exact tested commit is remotely verified
waypoints.boundary: No publication claim before remote verification.

waypoints.title: CueMastery pilot
waypoints.description: Use CueMastery as the first external project to validate engineering throughput and complexity reduction.
accept: One meaningful CueMastery objective completes with measured effort and recovery evidence
waypoints.boundary: Pilot changes require CueMastery-specific required reading and acceptance.

waypoints.title: Delivery and learning reconciliation
waypoints.description: Deliver artifacts, update project memory, measure provider effectiveness, and feed validated lessons into Riverview.
accept: Delivery includes provenance, operating guide, and measured lessons
waypoints.boundary: Lessons do not silently become global rules.

waypoints.title: Data separation and the Undercurrent
waypoints.description: Separate mechanisms from data and protect sensitive, private, credentialed, and adult-oriented material.
accept: Classification prevents prohibited cross-boundary access
Recovery preserves separation
waypoints.boundary: Undercurrent is explicit high-trust storage and processing, not a hidden duplicate Estate.

waypoints.title: Classification vocabulary
waypoints.description: Define public, operational, private, sensitive, credential, adult-local, and Undercurrent classes.
accept: Representative artifacts classify deterministically
waypoints.boundary: Unknown classification defaults closed.

waypoints.title: Storage reference boundary
waypoints.description: Keep source mechanisms separate from runtime data while recording hashes, owners, classification, and locations.
accept: Source repository contains no protected payloads
waypoints.boundary: Large and private artifacts are referenced, not embedded.

waypoints.title: Undercurrent access broker
waypoints.description: Require explicit capability and purpose for protected reads, writes, processing, and promotion.
accept: Ordinary River path cannot retrieve protected test record
waypoints.boundary: No implicit access through resident, model, or administrator identity.

waypoints.title: Credential lifecycle
waypoints.description: Replace bootstrap passwords with local protected storage, rotation, recovery, audit, and least privilege.
accept: Rotation script changes credentials without source edits
Recovery is documented
waypoints.boundary: No credentials in GitHub, chat reports, or ordinary logs.

waypoints.title: Encryption, backup, and restore
waypoints.description: Protect classified data at rest and in backup while retaining tested recovery and key separation.
accept: Encrypted backup restores under authorized identity
waypoints.boundary: Unrecoverable encryption is a failed design.

waypoints.title: Promotion and declassification
waypoints.description: Move approved summaries or artifacts from Undercurrent into ordinary River paths with provenance.
accept: Promotion records approver, source hash, transformation, and destination
waypoints.boundary: No automatic bulk declassification.

waypoints.title: Residents and creative continuity
waypoints.description: Preserve resident identities, roles, relationships, Chief Architects, Character Designers, and creative output.
accept: Resident continuity survives provider and interface changes
waypoints.boundary: Residents are respected participants and adapters, not kernel control logic.

waypoints.title: Resident registry and provenance
waypoints.description: Record identity, role, creator, continuity sources, capabilities, presentation, and classification needs.
accept: Each active resident resolves to authoritative continuity sources
waypoints.boundary: No resident is flattened into an interchangeable prompt.

waypoints.title: Character and role runtime
waypoints.description: Assemble bounded context for conversation, character design, architecture, entertainment, and project roles.
accept: Role-specific session loads correct identity and allowed tools
waypoints.boundary: Roleplay context cannot confer operational authority.

waypoints.title: Chief Architect and Character Designer workflows
waypoints.description: Preserve specialized design responsibilities and route their outputs into reviewed project artifacts.
accept: Design output retains author, rationale, review, and destination
waypoints.boundary: Advisory design does not bypass engineering acceptance.

waypoints.title: Creative and entertainment lanes
waypoints.description: Support ordinary and lawful adult-local creative interactions with provider and storage separation.
accept: Classification selects correct provider and protected storage
waypoints.boundary: OpenAI-restricted work remains on eligible local systems.

waypoints.title: Resident continuity evaluation
waypoints.description: Test identity stability, memory retrieval, role boundaries, and migration across interfaces.
accept: Steward accepts representative resident continuity sessions
waypoints.boundary: Evaluation uses agreed character goals, not generic assistant similarity.

waypoints.title: Physical infrastructure and operations
waypoints.description: Organize the server cabinet, hosts, storage, networking, power, thermal control, backups, and observability.
accept: Documented equipment layout and recovery drill
Health visible from Riverview
waypoints.boundary: Physical changes require safe power and hardware procedures.

waypoints.title: Hardware and cable inventory
waypoints.description: Record rack units, dimensions, power, network, USB, GPU, storage, spares, and cable endpoints.
accept: Every installed device and cable endpoint is labeled and recorded
waypoints.boundary: Inventory precedes physical rearrangement.

waypoints.title: Rack layout and service placement
waypoints.description: Plan the 44-inch-deep cabinet for airflow, serviceability, weight, cable paths, and expansion.
accept: Steward approves physical layout before move
waypoints.boundary: No unsafe lifting, power work, or airflow obstruction.

waypoints.title: Power, thermal, and network health
waypoints.description: Measure circuits, UPS behavior, temperatures, fans, link health, addresses, and failure alarms.
accept: Induced safe disconnect produces correct alert and recovery
waypoints.boundary: Monitoring cannot control hazardous power without separate authorization.

waypoints.title: Service topology and startup
waypoints.description: Assign hosts, ports, identities, dependencies, startup order, and bounded restart policies.
accept: Cold start reaches healthy state from documented procedure
waypoints.boundary: One service cannot silently own another service's ports or data.

waypoints.title: Backup and disaster recovery
waypoints.description: Back up PostgreSQL, repositories, configuration, protected data, and artifact indexes; test restore.
accept: Recovery drill restores a verified isolated environment
waypoints.boundary: Backups retain classification and credential separation.

waypoints.title: Operational observability
waypoints.description: Unify service health, GPU activity, capacity, database, storage, alerts, and diagnostic checkpoints.
accept: Steward dashboard identifies injected service failure
waypoints.boundary: Telemetry is bounded and excludes private content.

waypoints.title: Quest and 3D Estate environment
waypoints.description: Transition Riverview's residents, spaces, controls, and operational surfaces toward a Quest-compatible 3D environment.
accept: Steward completes representative Estate interaction in prototype
waypoints.boundary: 3D presentation consumes stable APIs and never becomes kernel authority.

waypoints.title: Spatial world model
waypoints.description: Define Estate locations, navigation, resident placement, interactive objects, and state references.
accept: World schema represents current Estate diagrams without losing roles
waypoints.boundary: Visual layout does not rewrite operational ownership.

waypoints.title: Resident avatar pipeline
waypoints.description: Create versioned 3D representations tied to resident identity, style, expression, and animation assets.
accept: Representative residents retain accepted identity across 2D and 3D
waypoints.boundary: Assets and sensitive variants follow classification rules.

waypoints.title: Spatial status and work interfaces
waypoints.description: Render roadmap, notifications, conversations, project rooms, and diagnostics as spatial consumers.
accept: 3D status matches PostgreSQL projection
waypoints.boundary: Spatial UI remains read-only until separately approved controls exist.

waypoints.title: Quest input and voice mapping
waypoints.description: Map controllers, gaze, hands, voice, and command-chair handoff into typed gestures and sessions.
accept: Representative inputs resolve without accidental privileged action
waypoints.boundary: Safety-critical actions retain explicit confirmation.

waypoints.title: Performance and presence acceptance
waypoints.description: Measure latency, frame rate, model responsiveness, comfort, reconnect, and degraded operation.
accept: Prototype meets Steward-defined comfort and responsiveness targets
waypoints.boundary: Performance optimization cannot weaken data or action boundaries.

waypoints.title: Estate migration and parity
waypoints.description: Move validated responsibilities from the existing Estate into Riverview through adapters, shadow operation, and controlled cutover.
accept: Required Estate outcomes operate through Riverview
Rollback remains available
waypoints.boundary: Reuse code only when it does not import unnecessary coupling.

waypoints.title: Estate capability inventory
waypoints.description: Map active services, residents, governance, data, control devices, integrations, and unfinished attempts.
accept: Inventory distinguishes active, valuable, obsolete, and unknown components
waypoints.boundary: Inventory does not imply wholesale code migration.

waypoints.title: Parity and intentional-difference matrix
waypoints.description: Define which outcomes must match, which mechanisms may differ, and which legacy behaviors retire.
accept: Steward accepts every required outcome and intentional difference
waypoints.boundary: Mission and residents are preserved; accidental complexity is not.

waypoints.title: Bounded compatibility adapters
waypoints.description: Reuse or wrap proven Estate components such as notifications and Stream Deck status without importing broad dependencies.
accept: Each adapter has explicit inputs, outputs, dependencies, and removal path
waypoints.boundary: No direct shared mutable state between Estate and Riverview.

waypoints.title: Data migration and verification
waypoints.description: Copy approved data with hashes, classifications, provenance, reconciliation, and rollback manifests.
accept: Counts, hashes, permissions, and sampled content reconcile
waypoints.boundary: Original data remains recoverable until final acceptance.

waypoints.title: Shadow operation and failure drills
waypoints.description: Run Riverview beside the Estate, compare outputs, induce failures, and measure troubleshooting time.
accept: Critical workflows meet parity and Cookbook recovery targets
waypoints.boundary: Shadow mode cannot execute duplicate destructive actions.

waypoints.title: Controlled cutover and legacy retirement
waypoints.description: Move authority capability by capability, retain rollback windows, and archive retired components.
accept: Steward approves each authority transfer
Legacy dependencies are removed or documented
waypoints.boundary: No big-bang cutover.

waypoints.title: Operational maturity and continuing expansion
waypoints.description: Prove Riverview remains understandable, diagnosable, secure, performant, and extensible as the Estate grows.
accept: New conversation repairs representative failures without archaeology
New project integrates without kernel redesign
waypoints.boundary: Maturity is evidence and practice, not endless governance.

waypoints.title: Cookbook coverage audit
waypoints.description: Ensure every runtime seam and failure checkpoint has current evidence, bounded probes, repair, and verification.
accept: Coverage report has no unexplained operational checkpoint gaps
waypoints.boundary: Documentation without executable evidence does not pass.

waypoints.title: Fresh-conversation recovery trials
waypoints.description: Give unfamiliar AI conversations source and Cookbook access, then measure diagnosis and repair time.
accept: Representative failures resolve from checkpoint evidence within agreed bounds
waypoints.boundary: Trials cannot depend on hidden conversation history.

waypoints.title: Security and Undercurrent review
waypoints.description: Test classification, credentials, access brokers, remote paths, backups, and promotion boundaries.
accept: Critical boundary tests pass and findings have owners
waypoints.boundary: Review avoids exposing protected payloads in evidence.

waypoints.title: Performance and capacity baseline
waypoints.description: Measure event, queue, worker, model, dashboard, storage, and recovery performance under representative load.
accept: Capacity envelope and scaling triggers are recorded
waypoints.boundary: Optimization follows measurement.

waypoints.title: Extension contract
waypoints.description: Prove new residents, providers, devices, projects, and interfaces attach through existing bounded contracts.
accept: One new capability integrates without changing kernel responsibilities
waypoints.boundary: New mechanisms require a responsibility existing components cannot absorb.

waypoints.title: Estate at Riverview acceptance
waypoints.description: Final mission, continuity, engineering, autonomy, diagnostics, operator experience, and expansion acceptance.
accept: Steward signs final acceptance
Outstanding limitations are explicit and scheduled
waypoints.boundary: Acceptance does not freeze future growth.
